summary: A 31-year-old man hiking below treeline between Dream Lake and Lake Haiyaha was struck by lightning. Other hikers found him and called rangers; the park SAR team carried him to the Bear Lake trailhead, where a helicopter flew him to the Medical Center of the Rockies in Loveland.
location: between Dream Lake and Lake Haiyaha
